admissibility_rule: A code is admissible only if the candidate population can vary it. GEPA varies only the four instruction strings summarize1, summarize2, create_query_hop2, create_query_hop3.

dropped.name: Pipeline_Terminates_With_Unresolved_Gaps
dropped.reason: Terminating after a fixed hop limit with gaps open is HoverMultiHop.forward's control flow, identical for every candidate.

dropped.name: Output_Contains_Duplicate_Documents
dropped.reason: retrieved_docs is hop1+hop2+hop3 concatenated with no dedup stage; duplicates are architectural and the metric ignores them entirely.

dropped.name: Retrieval_Accepts_Invalid_Query_Input
dropped.reason: Blames the fixed BM25 retriever for accepting any string. The candidate-side behaviour is already covered by B.4 Query_Output_Not_Usable_As_Search_Query.

dropped.name: Pipeline_Lacks_Early_Termination_Logic
dropped.reason: Names the absence of early-termination logic the architecture never had. No candidate can add control flow; GEPA edits instruction strings only.

dropped.name: Output_Includes_Irrelevant_Documents
dropped.reason: No filtering stage exists, and hover_retrieval_metric is recall-only (score = float(not missing_gold)) — irrelevant documents cannot lower the score.

dropped.name: Retrieval_System_Fails_On_Valid_Query
dropped.reason: Self-scopes to retrieval failures 'not from query formulation defects', i.e. it fires precisely when the candidate is blameless.
